programmes.d: This episode features stories of one woman who was convicted of the death of her adopted daughter and a handicapped man who was pushed into a river by his wife.
A woman explains why she hired a hitman to kill her fourth husband. Next, an addict watched as a fellow gang member robbed and murdered an unsuspecting man.
This episode profiles a woman who murdered her own father and stepmother for money. Then, a woman allegedly conspires to murder her husband's ex-wife.
This episode features a woman who shot her abusive husband and a bipolar woman who killed her 5-year-old stepdaughter after an argument.
This episode features a woman who murdered her own parents and a woman who helped her husband commit robbery and murder.
This episode features a woman who was convicted of murdering her millionaire husband and a woman who was an alleged accomplice in the fatal beating of a man held captive in her home.
A female cab driver is convicted of masterminding a cruel plot to murder a wheelchair user. Then, a woman robs and kills a liquor store clerk.
This episode features a mother who shot her two sons dead and a woman who allegedly set a fire that killed her boyfriend and his parents.
A woman and her husband are charged with beating a gay man to death. Then, a mother is convicted of the murder of her 8-month-old child.

A woman and her boyfriend are convicted of committing a fatal shooting at a local bar. Another woman lures a man into her car and watches as her husband robs him and shoots him five times at point-blank range.
A woman tells the story of how she was charged with killing a devoted friend. Later, a woman explains how she ended up behind bars after her son was mauled to death by a dog.
Donna claims that it was self-defense when she stabbed her boyfriend, Charles, 54 times. Next, 2-year-old Serinity died from injuries consistent with child abuse.
A woman is convicted of fatally shooting her ex-husband. Next, a woman is charged with killing her estranged husband.
A woman pleads guilty to the murder of a local prostitute. Later, we hear the story of a woman who played a role in a robbery that ended in the murder of a Chinese food delivery man.
A woman is convicted of killing a man she contacted through an online dating service. Another woman murders a man she had just met at a swinger's club.
This episode features a woman who was convicted of murdering her adoptive grandmother and a woman who shot a teenager after losing money playing a game.
A woman is charged with starting the fire that killed the two sleeping children of her lesbian lover. Then, a woman pleads guilty to first-degree manslaughter after stabbing a man.
Angela was found guilty of fatally stabbing her friend. Next, Sharon was convicted of the robbery and murder of her pimp.
A woman is convicted of fatally poisoning her husband. Then, a woman tells her story about how she was found guilty in the heroin death of her sex client.
A woman pleads guilty to murdering her husband. Then, Anita Gonzales is convicted of robbing and murdering an elderly man.
A woman pleads guilty in the group slaying of a religious family. LaSonya confesses to the stabbing death of her boyfriend in their apartment.
This episode features a woman who was convicted of killing an elderly woman and another who allegedly sexually violated a 21-year-old woman and then left her to die in a closet.
This episode features a woman who murdered two convenient store workers in Georgia and New York. Then, a woman tells her story of how she was convicted of murdering her elderly landlady.
This episode features a woman who murdered her husband and another who schemed to kill a witness in her nephew's murder case.
This episode features one woman who was convicted of fatally stabbing her boyfriend and dismembering his body. Then, another woman beats a 67-year-old woman and leaves her to die in a storage shed.
This episode features a woman who was convicted in the murder and dismemberment of a 21-year-old man. Then, a woman claims that she shot and killed her husband in self-defense.
